from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
for variant in ['FIRST','LAST']:
 evidence=base/('evidence-'+variant.lower())
 command=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id','DUPLICATE-ACTION-'+variant,
  '--generated-scenario-path','/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests/dev-06-silent-boss-scenario.json',
  '--combat-solver-build-dir',str(base/'build-native'),'--headless-instance','duplicate-action-'+variant.lower()+'-20261007',
  '--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(evidence),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 started=time.perf_counter()
 with (base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 summary={'variant':variant,'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-started}
 (base/('summary-'+variant.lower()+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
 if result.returncode:
  print((base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).read_text()[-4500:],flush=True)
  raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 print((base/('launcher-'+variant.lower()+'.log')).read_text()[-800:],flush=True)
